title: Establishment of 2D and 3D Primary Cell Cultures From Gastric and Gastroesophageal Junction Cancer
official: Establishment of 2D and 3D Primary Cell Cultures From Gastric and Gastroesophageal Junction Cancer
summary: In this study, the investigators will establish primary cell cultures from surgically resected gastric and gastroesophageal junction cancer specimen that were collected between 06/2018 and 05/2021.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with gastric or gastroesophageal junction cancer

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18 years

sites.f: Department of Anesthesiology and Operative Intensive Care Medicine CCM/CVK, Charité - Universitätsmedizin Berlin
